controls.objective: Reject newly created privileged containers and containers permitting privilege escalation.
controls.coverage: Regular and init containers on Pod CREATE; privileged=false and explicit allowPrivilegeEscalation=false.
limits: Does not implement the full Restricted Pod Security Standard, runAsNonRoot, capabilities, seccomp or ephemeral-container controls.
dependencies: Admission-controller availability and failure policy reviewed
platform_evidence: Positive and negative CREATE requests on the target API server
Existing-workload response and debug-subresource restrictions reviewed
controls.rollback: Move this control to Audit or restore its previous revision; assess each workload before replacement.

controls.objective: Route requirements beyond this admission compiler to their actual enforcement owner.
controls.coverage: Explicit unsupported requirement; no policy or security success is inferred.
limits: Reads, tool calls, evidence capture and existing processes require other enforcement layers.
dependencies: Named requirement owner and enforcement component
platform_evidence: Requirement-specific positive and negative runtime or application test
controls.rollback: Restore the reviewed enforcement component according to its own playbook.

exception_limits_basis: Proposed reference limits; enterprise owners must ratify them. No exception is granted.
